# Country scope. Theater 3: East Asian Rim decision/event participants.

}

# Country scope. Fast O(1) gate for oe_nbe_pulse.txt fallback pulse (fx17 rebel-guarded).
oe_nbe_pulse_candidate = {
    is_rebel_country = no
    OR = {

        tag = HAB

                oe_nbe_is_danube = yes
                oe_nbe_is_east_rim = yes
            }
        }
    }
}

# Any scope. Live non-rebel host checks for each theater.
oe_nbe_has_live_host_n = {
    has_global_variable = oe_nbe_host_n
    trigger_if = {
        limit = { has_global_variable = oe_nbe_host_n }
        country_exists = global_var:oe_nbe_host_n
        global_var:oe_nbe_host_n = { is_rebel_country = no }
    }
}

# Any scope. Read-only detection of vanilla Hussite Wars situation or Hussite faith.
oe_nbe_hussite_present = {
    OR = {
        situation:hussite_wars = { situation_is_active = yes }
        religion = religion:hussite
    }
}

# Any scope. Living New Rome (c:ROM or c:BYZ) for Danube diplomatic linkage.
oe_nbe_new_rome_alive = {
    OR = {
        AND = { country_exists = c:ROM c:ROM = { is_rebel_country = no } }
        AND = { country_exists = c:BYZ c:BYZ = { is_rebel_country = no } }
    }
}

# Any scope. Restored Mongol Yuan (c:CHI) verified via oe_y7_yuan_ok.
oe_nbe_yuan_restored = {
    country_exists = c:CHI
    c:CHI = { is_rebel_country = no }
    oe_y7_yuan_ok = yes
}
